entries.title: Ask HN: Is it possible to run your own mail server for personal use?
entries.author: jdmoreira
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Is it possible to run your own mail server for personal use?
entries.excerpt: Recently I decided that I wanted to run my own MTA. Downloaded qmail, applied a couple of patches and it was done. The problem is making sure my mail is not marked as spam by the major MTAs out there, gmail and hotmail both mark my mails as spam.
